SafeMath addition helper with a post-hoc require(c >= a) check.

Mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited balance account.
transfer debits msg.sender and credits 'to' in the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to compute the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to compute the recipient balance.
safeSub performs unchecked subtraction on balance state used by balances mapping.
safeAdd is a 0.4.24 addition relying only on a post-hoc comparison.
safeSub is a 0.4.24 subtraction without compiler overflow protection.
safeMul multiplication can silently wrap but is validated by a division check.
TITAN constructor assigns the full supply to _totalSupply.
TITAN constructor credits the full supply to a hardcoded balance.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf indexes balances with the tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] through the local return variable.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as the token owner.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without any sender restriction.
transferFrom debits 'from' and credits 'to' in balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] but never verifies the allowance is sufficient.
the caller-supplied 'from' address determines whose balance and allowance are spent.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall grants an allowance originating from msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
the spender parameter is cast to a contract and called back, making it untrusted code.
approveAndCall performs an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval.
the arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
the external receiveApproval call hands msg.sender to an attacker-controlled contract.
the tokens parameter is subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
the 'to' parameter receives the transferred tokens.
the _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer, restricted by onlyOwner.
the tokenAddress parameter is an arbitrary contract address invoked by the sweep function.

normalization_plan.reason: First arithmetic operand belongs to the SafeMath helper and carries no standalone semantics.
Second arithmetic operand belongs to the SafeMath helper and carries no standalone semantics.
Return local holding the SafeMath result is fully subsumed by the helper function.
Ownership candidate parameter only exists to update the newOwner state in transferOwnership.
Spender parameter is the untrusted callee address used by the approveAndCall external call.
Token amount parameter is consumed directly by the transfer balance arithmetic.
Source account parameter is only meaningful as the debited account inside transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is only meaningful as the credited account inside transfer.
Queried account parameter only serves as the balances mapping key in balanceOf.
Payload bytes are only relevant because they are forwarded to the untrusted external callback.
Arbitrary token contract address only matters as the target of the external ERC20 transfer.
Return local is a direct mirror of balances[tokenOwner] read in balanceOf.
